name: RAM Report Rush
hook: Spam Sam Altman's inbox with real-time graphs of every unused gigabyte
tagline: A terminal script fires automated diagnostic emails directly to the CEO inbox detailing criminal amounts of idle DDR5 memory. As the multiplier climbs, the email dispatch volume turns into a crushing denial-of-service avalanche of browser tabs. Cashing out submits an unsubscribe link in the nick of time, while crashing triggers an inbox bounceback that bricked your motherboard.
